size.linear_MAC_formula: 2699520*E + 147456*(Gkk+Gij), B=1; one MAC is one multiply-accumulate; excludes normalization, scatter, activation, I/O and topology

ordered_equations: return net=N8, delta=d_fc(ReLU(N8)), weight=sigmoid(w_fc(ReLU(N8))); GradientClip is inference identity, not an output clamp

SoftAgg.exact_formula: sorted_unique group inverse j; w_e,c=exp(g(x)_e,c-max_group,c)/sum_group exp; y_G,c=sum_e_in_group f(x)_e,c*w_e,c; output_e=h(y)_[j_e]
SoftAgg.float_reduction_order_note: Groups gather members in ascending original edge order to approximate the CPU reference order; hardware reduction reassociation remains subject to the fixed gate.

proposed_export_boundary.topology_inputs_or_constants: CPU prepared previous/next safe Gather indices + pre-MLP masks, sorted group inverse/member rows and validity masks; unchanged only while ordered ii/jj/kk and graph-local ID mapping remain unchanged.
proposed_export_boundary.operations: MatMul/Add/ReLU/Sigmoid/LayerNormalization/Gather/ReduceMax/Exp/ReduceSum/Div and shape constants. Avoid exporting Python neighbors or data-dependent unique as traced constants without an explicit topology binding.
proposed_export_boundary.grouped_representation: [1,G,L,384] membership Gather; max/exp/sum over L independently per channel; h over G then inverse Gather. Fixed examples need Lkk1 or3 and Lij96; no E-by-E-by384 score tensor.
proposed_export_boundary.memory_risk_example: E864 dense [E,E,384] FP32 would be 1146617856 bytes per intermediate; padded [G,L,384] should remain near E*384 when group sizes are balanced.
proposed_export_boundary.padding_contract: Invalid edges cannot enter real neighbor/SoftAgg groups or softmax denominators. Mask before maximum/exponential and avoid all-padding group 0/0. Channel LN of extra rows alone does not make naive E padding safe.
proposed_export_boundary.persistent_context: Init and original weight upload once per supported shape/topology plan; no per-Linear SDK crossings. Packing, topology preparation/update, submit/run/get, owned copy/release and CPU pieces must remain in complete-call timing.
proposed_export_boundary.not_implemented_or_verified: No RKNN node target, speed, quality, dynamic topology or production execution is established by this review.

minimal_reductions_without_weight_change: For all-singleton kk groups (captured E96 only), w=1 so omit g/softmax while retaining the original f and h operations; prove original fixed FP32 output first. This saves E*384*384 MACs in that specialized topology, not all general graphs.

Cache original neighbors and grouping once per ordered topology revision instead of sorting/unique every numerical iteration. Do not reuse across edge insertion/removal/reorder or keyframe index compaction.
Keep h on groups; evaluating h on E expanded rows duplicates work. Do not pre-compose learned f/h weights because that changes floating-point rounding.
Keep all original layers and recurrence; do not drop an aggregate or reduce E, P, update iterations, hidden width or image size under an equivalence claim.
numerical_and_runtime_risks: FP16 dense/LN/Exp/Sigmoid and compiler reassociation may fail rtol1e-4/atol1e-5 even when a graph compiles; v27 InstanceNorm is a concrete warning against relaxed posthoc gates.
LayerNorm is four eps1e-3 per-edge channel norms, not InstanceNorm or eps1e-5; its reductions must retain the original statistic axis.
Mask invalid neighbor before c1/c2, never mask their outputs: biased c(0) is part of the original result.
Stable ties in jj sorting within kk matter; -1 Gather must be safely mapped with an explicit mask and must not select a different real edge for valid entries.
Group logits are per-channel and require stable group maximum. Padding must not introduce finite bias logits into real group denominators.

Original ii*12345+jj uses graph-local int64 IDs; do not substitute large source timestamps/frame IDs or silently change grouping to pair tuples. Check arithmetic overflow and keep original defined ID domain.
SDK actual native layout/name/type, FP32 input packing, output copy-before-release, context destroy and E RKNN stderr failures must be checked independently of API return code.
Fixed identity correlation with zero net tests one input only. Saved steps0..3 exercise nonzero recurrent inputs but still hold graph/context/correlation fixed and are not trajectory validation.

The 13-input graph has six int64 index tensors and seven FP32 tensors; a reused float-only SDK adapter is insufficient. Bind each native attr type and original logical shape, keep integer ranges exact and disallow implicit FP32 IDs. SDK datatype support/conversion must be verified on the actual compiled graph.
